summary: Wellchange Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting the removal of two independent directors, Wang Yiyun and Liu Jun, effective June 9, 2026, followed by the appointment of new independent directors Lau Yun Chau and Lau Chun on June 10, 2026. The board reconstituted committees accordingly, with Lau Chun assuming the compensation committee chair previously held by Wang Yiyun and Lau Yun Chau taking Liu Jun's committee roles. The board now consists of six directors, with a majority independent. This is an abrupt board change outside a routine meeting cycle, qualifying as a management shake-up. Watch for potential governance disputes or strategic shifts as new directors settle in.
